title: Floral Sheer Blouse & Flare Jeans
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair walks along a wet stone path beside a low hedge. She wears a sheer amber floral blouse with flared sleeves, a tie front, and a white cami underneath. A silver conchos belt cinches her waist. Light-wash flared jeans complete the look. Her expression is calm, with her gaze to the side. Soft autumn daylight, a palette of amber, rust, and pale denim. Earthy and relaxed, in the style of an autumn street-style editorial.
workingNotes:
- The sheer floral blouse and flared jeans are the defining silhouette.
- Keep the wet path and hedge for an outdoor autumn setting.
